## In global mode

In global mode: your global install keeps one Astryx skill in your home folder, linked into the folders agent tools read, so agents outside any project know Astryx is there; inside a project, its own agent docs come first. See `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global` and `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global/computer-agent-guide`.

Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs working-with-ai --index
Previous: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs working-with-ai mcp-server
